question: What staff is made up to the uvula and what lies above it?
premises: Then make the staff named Ananta.
It extends up to the uvula.
It ends in tanmatras and kalas.
Above it is a knot of night-nature.
inference: The Ananta staff reaches the uvula, and a night-nature knot lies above it.
uncertainties: lambikāvadhi may mean up to the uvula or palate.
plain_english: Then make the staff named Ananta up to the uvula, ending in tanmatras and kalas; above that is a knot of night-nature.
